desc:
The Vector Origin pays homage to the years of product development and engineering that went into creating the groundbreaking KRISS Super V recoil mitigation system, and serves as a bookmark in KRISS company history as they strive to bring more unique and innovative products to market.
Combining the original looks of early Vector prototypes that began the KRISS journey with the refinements of the modern-day Vector, the Vector Origin will be offered as a .45ACP carbine with a 16” barrel, round barrel shroud, hinged upper receiver with side folding stock, skeletonized trigger, and accessorized with steel folding sights and vertical grip, all packed in a custom cut foam hard case.
